ITEM 1 | Shredded orange-red meat-like mound with stringy fibers, glossy saucy sheen, some darker red-orange edges and browned bits, piled in a loose heap about 10 cm tall-ish footprint roughly 9 x 8 cm, sitting on the upper-left of the plate with a melted orange cheese-like layer beneath the top | 210
ITEM 2 | Chopped green salad mix of diced pale green cucumber cubes (about 1 cm), small red pepper pieces, and dark green leafy herbs or greens with a light moist sheen, scattered in a mound about 9 x 6 cm, low profile about 1.5 cm high, lying beside the meat mound at lower-left | 95
ITEM 3 | Slice of whole-grain bread, golden-tan crust edge with speckled seeds on the crumb, soft matte interior, triangular wedge about 10 x 6 cm and 2 cm thick, sitting at upper-right of the plate | 55
ITEM 4 | Watermelon chunks, bright red flesh with small dark seeds visible, juicy moist surface, cut into irregular triangular/cubic pieces about 3-4 cm each, five to six pieces arranged in a cluster at right side of the plate | 150
